name: tealun-skills
description: Tealun Skills: a PDCA development loop for AI coding agents. planner (Plan), tasker (Do), auditor and bugfixer (Check), evolver (Act), evidence-first and handing off to each other, plus explainer, which explains the code in plain language.

plugins.name: tealun-skills
plugins.description: Five skills forming a PDCA loop: planner (plan before code), tasker (checkable changes with evidence), bugfixer (reproduce, prove the cause, fix, guard), auditor (evidence-backed audits), evolver (turn verified lessons into guards and ledger records); plus explainer (read-only, plain-language explanations of the codebase with file paths).
